newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were lower in late trading on Wednesday, with demand staying weak amid the on-going election campaign, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,425-30 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,430-35 rupiah at the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,420 rupiah. Crude palm oil was on offer at around 1,225 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.

"The market was quiet in the absence of fresh factors due to a holiday in Malaysia," one trader said. "Buying interest was also thin because of the on-going election campaign as buyers are cautious following some rioting yesterday."

Election-related violence hit several parts of Jakarta on Tuesday, and in one incident soldiers fired into the air in the capital to disperse thousands of supporters of the Moslem-backed minority United Development Party (PPP).
The situation was relatively calm on Wednesday, with only one reported clash between students and supporters of the ruling Golkar party in the southern outskirts of Jakarta.
The traders said prices were also under pressure from falls in Europe overnight and in Malaysia on Tuesday.
The market will be closed on Thursday for a holiday. Trading resumes on Friday. -- Jakarta newsroom + 6221 384-6364
